jsonld.name: Quebec SMB AI & Automation Barometer — 2026 edition
jsonld.description: Annual survey on AI and automation adoption in Quebec SMBs: actual use, hours lost to manual tasks, obstacles and budgets.

page.title: Where do Quebec SMBs <italic>really</italic> stand with AI?
page.lead: The big surveys measure adoption. Nobody measures what happens on the ground: how many hours a week still go to manual data entry, who uses AI behind the boss’s back, and what actually blocks projects. This barometer asks those questions, to SMB owners and managers like you. The compiled results — by sector and by size — will be published here, free of charge.
page.ctaNote: Anonymous. Email is optional and only used to send you the results first.

known.kicker: What we already know — and the gap
known.sub: of Quebec businesses use AI (Institut de la statistique du Québec, 2024-2025), while 52% of Quebec adults use it in their personal lives (NETendances 2025).
known.plus: Why the gap? That’s exactly what this barometer measures.

steps.title: You answer — 2 minutes
steps.text: Eleven multiple-choice questions: your data, your manual hours, your use of AI, your obstacles, your budget. No right or wrong answers.

steps.title: I compile — anonymously
steps.text: Answers are aggregated by sector and by company size. No individual answer is ever published or shared — ever.

steps.title: Everyone gets the results
steps.text: The compiled figures are published on this page and sent first to participants who left their email — with the breakdown by sector, so you can compare yourself to your peers.

survey.title: Eleven questions. <italic>Your peers want your answers.</italic>
survey.lead: Every answer makes the picture more accurate — especially if your business hasn’t “done anything” with AI yet: that’s precisely the reality official surveys struggle to capture.

donnees.label: Your business data (customers, products, orders) mostly lives…
options: In emails, on paper or in people’s heads
In one or more software tools (POS, CRM, accounting)
A mix of all of the above

heures.label: Hours per week spent on repetitive manual tasks (data entry, copying, reports), across the whole company

ia_usage.label: Generative AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot…) at your company is…
options: Built into at least one business process

automatisation.label: Have you automated at least one process in the last 12 months?

obstacle.label: Your main obstacle to automation or AI
options: No time to deal with it
We don’t know where to start
Not convinced of the return on investment

budget.label: Planned budget for automation or AI over the next 12 months

penurie.label: Is the difficulty hiring pushing you toward automation?

loi25.label: Quebec’s Law 25 (personal information protection), at your company…
options: We know about it, but we’re not compliant
We’ve heard of it, nothing more
